source_scope: Five exact HTML files from C25-R6-01, read and section-inventoried; targeted external spot-check only, not full line-by-line source verification
wiki_method: Prefer links to well-covered Wikipedia articles; originality must be demonstrated for situated communal practice, evidence, territorial action or collaborative open research

observations: HTML has seven main sections: definitions, historical chronology, mechanisms, nonviolent civic responses, critical review, references.
Source already distinguishes historical fascism and broader extreme right and warns against simplistic causal generalizations.
Wikipedia already has a substantive historical article: duplicating a general encyclopedia history is unwarranted.
Source includes USHMM, Mémorial de la Shoah, Council of Europe and academic/publishing starting points.
required: Define distinctive Interstice value: documented collective historical verification, primary archival contributions and open questions.
Validate historical statements point-by-point, especially claimed named resource and role of women and minority resistance, before editorial visa.
Add actual historical local/collective case studies or prefer link to Wikipedia, keeping reference pathways.
Clarify contemporary usage of political labels with attributed criteria and the difference between nonviolent advocacy and historical resistance.

external_checked.result: Topic thoroughly treated; no automatic replacement for source-specific contextual research

observations: HTML has nine sections covering concepts, history, everyday experiences, statistical methods, rights, testimony and avenues of contribution.
The article distinguishes recorded incidents, victimization, criminal convictions and underreporting; a useful nonduplicative methodological angle.
The 2024 SSMSI 9,350 crimes/delicts figure is supported by the CNCDH report for 2024, published 2025.
The CNCDH report about 2025 was published June 2026 and separately records 9,737 incidents in 2025; avoid mislabelling reports by publication year.
required: Explicitly disambiguate CNCDH rapport sur l'année 2024 (published 2025) and rapport sur l'année 2025 (published 2026).
If discussing recent trends, consider 2025 (9,737) with separate year, definition and denominator, not silently substituting for 2024.
For each legal remedy provide a current jurisdiction, date and official source; require legal review.
Consent and anonymization workflow for testimonies before any collection; no operational activation.

observations: HTML has eleven sections and multiple topic lists under repair, workshops, energy, water, habitat and knowledge transfer.
Repeated 'Documentation technique détaillée et relecture à compléter' signals a directory of future fiches rather than verified step-by-step procedures.
Source explicitly warns about electrical qualifications, safe water use and not representing DIY solutions as automatically safe.
Wikipedia covers concepts such as low-tech and Fab labs; Interstice's justified niche could be safe, reproducible, peer-reviewed community practices.
required: No operational how-to for power, structural safety, drinking water, gas, wiring or food safety until qualified validation and measurements.
Use citations and precise dates from relevant regulators for water reuse, electrical safety, urban planning and insurance.
Add one complete concrete low-risk pilot with bill of materials, measurements, source and test limits before claiming a reusable tutorial.
Recheck each 'resource de départ' for its exact relevance: generic organizations' homepages are not proof of technical assertions.

external_checked.result: Rainwater not drinking/cooking; official restriction as stated in the article; usage context to be versioned

observations: HTML has eleven sections: terms, labor history, poverty and inequality, labor law, alternative economic forms and practical exercises.
The 2024 figures 15.4% poverty, about 9.8 million persons and median monthly standard of living EUR 2,228 were verified against Insee Première 2117 published July 2026.
The article correctly warns that median standard of living is not median salary and identifies limits of the household survey population.
Numerous entries are expressly marked 'Bibliographie spécialisée à compléter' and cannot be treated as independently verified.
required: Keep the Insee reference direct and clearly attach data year 2024, publication year 2026, geographical/household scope and unit-of-consumption methodology.
Do not reproduce another general encyclopedia overview without added concrete value: worker self-management, workplace inquiry, reading financial statements and wage documentation.
Date labor-law references to precise articles and verify applicability for organization size and sector.
Distinguish normative anticapitalist perspectives from descriptive evidence and competing economic models.

external_checked.result: 15.4%; 9.8 million; EUR 2,228 level of living median validated for 2024

observations: HTML has thirteen main sections and 31 initial topical notices plus a specific directory for French artists and intermittents.

Support each of 31 capsules with claim-level sources or reclassify openly as an incomplete directory of research questions.
